title: Weakly etale morphisms tested on affine opens, plus restriction to open subschemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the standard four-way characterization of weakly etale morphisms of schemes (globally; on every pair of affine opens; for some open coverings; for some affine open coverings via weakly etale ring maps), plus the permanence statement that any restriction U -> V of a weakly etale f : X -> S with f(U) subset V is again weakly etale. The retained proof is written: openness of U x_V U inside X x_S X (Schemes, lemma open-fibre-product) identifies the diagonal of the restriction with the restriction of the diagonal; flatness being local on source and target (Morphisms, lemma flat-characterize) then gives both the restriction permanence and the (1) iff (3) equivalence; the affine-ring dictionary (a map of affines is weakly etale exactly when the ring map is, again via flat-characterize applied to the module and diagonal flatness) yields (1) iff (2) iff (4). The retained statement contains one authorial typo (X x_Y X where X x_S X is meant, a stray Y from a template); it is preserved verbatim by span assembly and flagged here, not silently corrected. Retained author proof at lines 18956-18971.
